traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and named requirements in docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified: - Core functionality: `valid-story-reference` validates that @story paths point to existing `.story.md` files, with tests for valid and missing cases. - Quality & safety: File system access is synchronous but fully wrapped in try/catch, with a cache to avoid redundant IO, matching the intent of safe, efficient ESLint rule design. - Integration: The rule works alongside the annotation-format rule and uses standard ESLint RuleTester/Jest patterns. - User experience: Clear, specific messages (`fileMissing`, `invalidExtension`, `invalidPath`, `fileAccessError`) include the offending path and, for fs errors, the underlying error text. - Error handling: Filesystem errors are distinguished from missing files and surfaced via `fileAccessError` diagnostics; tests simulate EACCES/EIO and confirm no uncaught exceptions. - Documentation: Dedicated rule documentation explains behavior, options, and boundary rules, aligned with the story’s specification.
Given the passing targeted tests, the aligned implementation, and the supporting documentation, this story is fully implemented.
